# Morning Meeting Feelings Check-In

Subject: SEL and Advisory
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Check-In Routine
NYS framework label: NYS SEL Benchmarks and local advisory goals

## Short Description
A gentle feelings check-in with picture-supported prompts and teacher follow-up options.

## Alignment Note
Supports self-awareness, communication, belonging, and classroom community routines.

## Classroom Use Case
Use at arrival or morning meeting to normalize feelings language and support readiness.

## Preview Content
- Today I feel
- One thing I need
- Teacher follow-up note

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
